SuccessStory.Name: JUNTIAN
SuccessStory.Story:
Applying to the University of Guelph with a 85% (Ontario) // 3.67 (USA) // 35 (IB) GPA, Juntian could receive:

First Year Scholarships: $15,000 CAD

• President’s International Entrance Scholarship ($5,500)
• University International Scholarship ($5,000)
• Dean’s International Scholarship ($2,500)
• International Tuition Scholarship ($2,000)

Year 2-4 Funding: $49,500 CAD

• University International Scholarship ($15,000)
• Dean’s International Scholarship ($7,500)
• Work-Study Part Time Job ($22,000)
• Additional In-Course Scholarships ($5,000)
